messages:
Lauren (Customer Success): FYI invoice 4821 for AcmeHealth attempted a card charge this AM and got decline code `do_not_honor`. Customer is on a call and wants to pay today — can we retry or give them ACH/wire options? @Maria (Finance) any preference? :grimacing:

Maria (Finance): I can kick one immediate manual retry via Stripe and also send an ACH link. If they prefer wire, we'll email wire instructions. Need the billing contact email to send secure link.

Lauren (Customer Success): billing@acmehealth.com. They said their bank is rejecting micro-deposits with "unsupported account type" — might be a business savings account. They can provide routing + acct number if we accept manual ACH verification.

billing-bot: [payment.failed] invoice=4821 customer=AcmeHealth code=do_not_honor provider=Stripe id=pi_3Kx... log=\"card_decline_do_not_honor\"

Sam (Ops): Quick notes: 1) Wait ~5–10m between auth attempts to avoid duplicate auths. 2) Our automated retry schedule is 24h & 72h, but we can do one manual retry now. If you want me to trigger it, say so and I'll run it from the console. :gear:

Jordan (Sales): Please hold fulfillment until we have either cleared payment or wire confirmation. If they switch to ACH today we can waive the one-time late fee as a gesture — mention that to help close. :+1:

Maria (Finance): For ACH we should offer the Plaid flow first (easier). Link (secure): https://pay.redwood.example/plaid?cid=acmehealth-4821 — send only to billing contact. Note: if bank blocks micro-deposits, we accept one of the following for manual verification: 1) bank letter on letterhead confirming account + routing, 2) a bank-authenticated PDF or screenshot showing account and account holder name, or 3) same-day wire confirmation. Micro-deposit amounts we use are typically `$0.12` and `$0.23` (they'll appear in 1–2 business days).

Maria (Finance): If they want to wire, here's our wire template (paste into secure email):

```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: First National Bank of Redwood
Routing (ACH): 061000104
Account #: 987654321
SWIFT: FNBUS33
Reference: INVOICE 4821 / AcmeHealth
```

Maria (Finance): Once they send proof of the outgoing wire (bank confirmation or SWIFT copy) we can mark invoice as paid pending settlement and release. I'll also create a temporary "manual pay" note in QuickBooks so AR doesn't double-send reminders.

Lauren (Customer Success): Sent the Plaid link and the wire template to billing@acmehealth.com. Customer replied they will try wire today and email the outgoing confirmation screenshot. I'll post proof here when it arrives. Thanks everyone. :pray:
